summary: Mitesco, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting several routine financing and operational actions: a software development agreement with a Boca Raton consulting group for hourly fees plus 1,000,000 restricted shares; extensions of five 2025 Bridge Notes (aggregate $200,000) to September 1 and December 31, 2026; suspension of Series A Preferred redemption pending negotiation of an alternative structure by September 30, 2026; new funding of $20,000 from AJB and $160,000 in 60-day term notes from two lenders; and press releases on the preferred change and a home automation offering. These are ordinary financing and contract items, not a special-situation event. No deal terms were disclosed in terms of price per share or premium. What to watch: whether the preferred restructuring leads to a material event later.
